newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-New banks make yr loss says Westpac.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-New banks make yr loss says Westpac.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp Ltd said on Tuesday that its recent acquisitions, Challenge Bank in Australia and Trust Bank in New Zealand, contributed a net loss of A$1 million to the Westpac group's result for 1995/96.
But it said it expected the two new banks would contribute to earnings per share growth in 1996/97.
"Challenge Bank and Trust Bank contributed a A$1 million net loss after tax and amortisation of intangibles," Westpac said.
"As foreshadowed, these acquisitions had a minimal dilution impact on earnings per share of 1.8 cents per share," it said.
"We anticipate that the acquisitions should positively contribute to earnings per share (EPS) growth in 1997 and beyond, as integration benefits are realised," he Westpac said.
Westpac bought Challenge in December 1995 for A$685 million, saying it saw some EPS dilution initially.
Westpac announced in April a A$1.3 billion takeover bid for Trust Bank New Zealand, adding in May that it did not expect any eps boost from the purcahse.
Earlier Westpac reported that net profit before abnormals rose 11.5 percent to A$1.132 billion from A$1.015 billion the previous year.
Analysts had on average expected a net profit before abnormals of A$1.12 billion.
